whenToUse: Latest posts on a homepage, a blog index, or a category archive.
Any CMS feed mapped to PostSummary.
avoidWhen: Admin post management — use Data Table or the list-01 block.
A single article — use Article layout.
a11y: Each card has one link (the title) instead of nested links; dates use time elements.
Cover images need alt text or are marked decorative when the title says it all.
